data.title: Shaping the Future of Global Health: 'Go Healthy with Taiwan 2026' Unveils Top 20 Innovators from 62 Nations
data.description: In the global campaign "Go Healthy with Taiwan 2026," 20 semifinalists have been chosen from 832 submissions spanning 62 countries. The shortlisted teams represent 16 nations including Australia, Brazil, Canada, Ethiopia, France, India, Israel, Japan, Malawi, New Zealand, Philippines, Poland, Spain, Tunisia, Ukraine, and the U.S.A. This highlights the extensive international diversity and innovation present in the competition. Two more selection rounds are yet to take place.

data.title: IS SKINCARE GETTING TOO COMPLICATED? CERAVE MAKES THE CASE FOR SAFETY, EFFICACY AND SIMPLICITY
data.description: In a recent study conducted in Europe, it was discovered that a significant 81% of respondents understand the significance of safeguarding their skin beyond just protection from UV rays. Surprisingly, only 22% reported using products specifically designed to support the skin barrier. This research brings attention to the gap between awareness and action when it comes to skincare. CeraVe, a well-known skincare brand created in collaboration with dermatologists and endorsed by over 80,000 individuals, aims to bridge this divide and promote comprehensive skin health.

data.title: FAA Boosts Boeing 737 Max 10 Certification Hopes With Software Glitch Ruling
data.description: On Friday, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced that the latest software issue reported by Boeing does not pose a threat to flight safety. This determination has allowed the certification process for the Boeing 737 Max 10 to resume smoothly. The FAA's ruling has increased hopes for the certification of the 737 Max 10 model. This decision was shared in an update provided by Investor's Business Daily.

data.title: City of Stockbridge Receives Highest Level of Audit Assurance on 2025 Financial Statements
data.description: Stockbridge, Georgia, wrapped up the fiscal year ending on December 31, 2025, with a substantial $17.9 million in its General Fund balance. This achievement showcases Stockbridge's efficient financial management and positions it well for future initiatives and investments.

data.title: Phillips & Associates Sets Date for 2027 National Plaintiffs' Summit on Sexual Harassment & Employment Discrimination
data.description: A major conference for employment attorneys representing plaintiffs is scheduled to take place from March 14 to 16, 2027, at the Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa.
